# Skeleton

Skeletons hold the layout while content loads. Four primitives (line, rectangle, circle, square) with two gradient directions and a 2-second opacity pulse, composable into loading patterns for cards, lists, and profiles. Ported from the DGA library's dga-skeleton family.

**Stylesheet:** `components/skeleton/skeleton.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes, mapped from the library's dga-line-skeleton, dga-rectangle-skeleton, dga-circle-skeleton, and dga-square-skeleton APIs.

| Class | Type | Library prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.skeleton` | Base | — | Gradient placeholder with the 2s opacity pulse. Combine with a shape modifier. |
| `.skeleton--type2` | Modifier | `type` | Reverses the gradient direction (dark-to-light). Default is light-to-dark. |
| .skeleton--line + --sm\|--lg | Shape | `size` | Text-line placeholder, 277px wide, 14px or 22px tall, 8px radius. |
| .skeleton--rectangle + --sm\|--md\|--lg [+ --short] | Shape | size, width | Block placeholder, 320px wide × 24/32/40px tall; --short shrinks to button width (59/75/90px). |
| `.skeleton--circle` | Shape | `width` | Avatar/icon placeholder. Size with inline width/height (default 48px). |
| .skeleton--square [+ --rounded] | Shape | width, radius | Image/chart placeholder. Size with inline width/height (default 80px). |
| `.skeleton-pattern*` | Layout | — | Composition wrappers: __wrapper (24px column), __lines (12px column), __row/__col (media + text), __first/ __last (start-aligned rows). |

## Shapes

The four primitives. Lines hold text, rectangles hold fields and buttons, circles hold avatars, squares hold imagery.

```html
<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap: var(--spacing-lg);">
    <span class="skeleton skeleton--line skeleton--lg"></span>
    <span class="skeleton skeleton--line skeleton--sm"></span>
</div>
<span class="skeleton skeleton--rectangle skeleton--md"></span>


<span class="skeleton skeleton--circle"></span>
<span class="skeleton skeleton--circle" style="width:64px;height:64px;"></span>
<span class="skeleton skeleton--square"></span>
<span class="skeleton skeleton--square skeleton--rounded" style="width:120px;height:80px;"></span>
```

## Rectangle Sizes

Three heights at full width, and the short variant sized for buttons.

```html
<span class="skeleton skeleton--rectangle skeleton--lg"></span>
<span class="skeleton skeleton--rectangle skeleton--md"></span>
<span class="skeleton skeleton--rectangle skeleton--sm"></span>

    <span class="skeleton skeleton--rectangle skeleton--lg skeleton--short"></span>
    <span class="skeleton skeleton--rectangle skeleton--md skeleton--short"></span>
    <span class="skeleton skeleton--rectangle skeleton--sm skeleton--short"></span>
```

## Gradient Directions

Type 1 runs light-to-dark; type 2 reverses it. Alternate directions between adjacent placeholders for a subtler texture.

```html
<span class="skeleton skeleton--line skeleton--lg" style="width: 320px;"></span>
<span class="skeleton skeleton--type2 skeleton--line skeleton--lg" style="width: 320px;"></span>
```

## Patterns

Primitives composed into common loading layouts: a profile row, a media card, and an icon list.

```html
<div class="skeleton-pattern">
    <div class="skeleton-pattern__row">
        <span class="skeleton skeleton--circle"></span>
        <div class="skeleton-pattern__col">
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--line skeleton--sm" style="width:160px;"></span>
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--type2 skeleton--line skeleton--sm" style="width:110px;"></span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="skeleton-pattern">
    <div class="skeleton-pattern__wrapper">
        <span class="skeleton skeleton--square" style="width:220px;height:120px;"></span>
        <div class="skeleton-pattern__lines">
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--line skeleton--lg" style="width:220px;"></span>
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--type2 skeleton--line skeleton--sm" style="width:220px;"></span>
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--line skeleton--sm" style="width:150px;"></span>
        </div>
        <span class="skeleton skeleton--rectangle skeleton--md skeleton--short skeleton-pattern__last"></span>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="skeleton-pattern">
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap: var(--spacing-xl);">
        <div class="skeleton-pattern__row">
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--circle" style="width:24px;height:24px;"></span>
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--line skeleton--sm" style="width:140px;"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="skeleton-pattern__row">
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--circle" style="width:24px;height:24px;"></span>
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--type2 skeleton--line skeleton--sm" style="width:120px;"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="skeleton-pattern__row">
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--circle" style="width:24px;height:24px;"></span>
            <span class="skeleton skeleton--line skeleton--sm" style="width:130px;"></span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Reduced Motion

When the user prefers reduced motion, the pulse stops and skeletons render as static placeholders. No extra classes needed.

```html
<span class="skeleton skeleton--line skeleton--lg" style="animation: none; width: 320px;"></span>
```
